verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows AvaTax's nexus API only lets a company *declare* where it has nexus, and separate products (Managed Returns, ECM) handle filing returns and certificates — none of the docs describe Avalara actually filing state/local sales tax permit registrations on the customer's behalf, nor any per-registration pricing or registration status tracking. A community comment explicitly states that using AvaTax still requires handling per-jurisdiction tax registration separately, reinforcing that this is not an in-product capability.
